This is Bluqar

Where the lake becomes your home.

Bluqar is a Royal Belum boat and houseboat operator based around Pulau Banding. Guests can arrange boat transport and lake exploration, or stay overnight aboard a large houseboat while travelling through the Temenggor lake landscape.

Slow mornings on the water, outdoor adventures during the day and unforgettable moments shared with family and friends.

Before You Go

Questions?
Start here.

Final answers can be updated once Bluqar confirms their operating details.

Bluqar Houseboat operates around the Royal Belum / Pulau Banding area in Perak. Exact meeting and boarding instructions can be provided when your booking is confirmed.

Bluqar can cater to houseboat escapes and nature experiences for families, friends and groups. Contact the team with your preferred date and group size for the most suitable option.

Houseboat capacity and sleeping arrangements should be confirmed directly with Bluqar based on your preferred trip and group requirements.

Inclusions may depend on the package selected. Ask the Bluqar team for the latest package inclusions, activities and meal arrangements before confirming your trip.

Use the enquiry form below or WhatsApp Bluqar directly with your preferred date, number of guests and trip duration.

Demo Experience Preview

What could your Royal Belum escape look like?

This is a visual demo only. Actual itinerary, activities and inclusions should be confirmed by Bluqar Houseboat.

Day 01

Arrive at the meeting point, board the houseboat, settle in and begin your journey onto the lake. Enjoy the scenery and your first afternoon surrounded by Royal Belum.

Day 02

Wake up on the water and spend the day exploring selected nature attractions, lake activities or rainforest experiences depending on your package.

Day 03

Enjoy a final slow morning on the lake before returning to the boarding point with plenty of memories — and probably hundreds of photos.

Sample only. Duration, destinations, meals, activities and operating schedule may differ.
